purpose: Define offer/answer/candidate and equivalent signaling messages as inert bootstrap metadata used to establish P2P transport.

topics.name: Peer Signaling Exchange
topics.purpose: Define offer/answer/candidate and equivalent signaling messages as inert bootstrap metadata used to establish P2P transport.

semantics.peer_rule: Sender/recipient peer refs are exact where authenticated.
semantics.payload_rule: Signaling payload cannot directly invoke application operations.
semantics.candidate_rule: Network candidates are transport metadata only.
semantics.replay_rule: Replay/stale signaling is rejected or bounded by explicit transaction identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Successful signaling grants no app authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: signaling payload treated canonical app data

references.purpose: Signaling passes through declared rendezvous service.
